$comment: Fields of parts.json (generated by LabeledModel.build() in model.py). Coordinates are in the design pose, in mm. Labels are in the user's language; lang is the viewer UI language (en / ja, null = detect from labels). filaments lists the filaments the parts use, in slicer order (filament 1, 2, ...; material null = not decided yet); it is empty for models without filaments, each part's filament is then null, and groups have no filaments key. groups[].filaments (multi-color models only) are the filaments printed in that piece after overlaps are resolved (later parts win); groups[].hidden_parts (pieces with two or more filaments only) lists the parts entirely covered by later parts of other filaments. print_settings holds the slicer settings from set_print_settings in plain words (model: whole model; groups: per print_group, winning over model; reason: why, in the user's language); empty objects when none are set.
title: Phone stand

print_layout.$comment: Layout of the print-pose pieces on the printer's bed (p3d.layout). matrix above already includes it. Plate k is centered at x = (k-1) * plate_pitch_mm; bed_fit is fits / diagonal / too_big / blocked (fits the bed only over an area the printer keeps free). edge_margin_mm is how far the pieces keep from the bed's edges (15, or 10 / 5 / 0 when that saves a plate); exclude_mm the areas the printer keeps free ([x0, y0, x1, y1] from the bed's front-left corner).

print_settings.reason: R3: holds a phone, so 3 walls and 25 % infill

print_note: Print with the bottom of the base down

parts.label: Base
parts.description: Plate that sits on the bed
